March 9, 2018 - By Maria Brooks

Institute For Wealth Management Llc acquired 57,823 shares as Apple Inc (AAPL)’s stock rose 12.78%. The Institute For Wealth Management Llc holds 58,123 shares with $8.95 million value, up from 300 last quarter. Apple Inc now has $910.73B valuation. The stock increased 1.44% or $2.55   $179.49. About 19.12 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 62.48%   outperformed by 45.78% the S&P500. 
American National Bankshares Inc. operates as the bank holding firm for American National Bank and Trust Company that provides financial services and products. The company has market cap of $331.32 million. The firm operates through two divisions, Community Banking, and Trust and Investment Services. It has a 21.76 P/E ratio. It accepts deposit products, including checking, money market, savings, and consumer and commercial time deposits, as well as certificates of deposit.
